verdict.rationale: Smithery has an official, still-maintained CLI (npm smithery@latest), but its documented commands cover only registry search and add/list/remove of MCP servers plus tool calls. That delivers the 'install into agents' step and nothing else. Publishing is documented only as a web URL flow, and the shutdown notice says Smithery accounts, API keys and the service-tied CLI versions stopped working. Missing for 10: a CLI authentication/login command, a CLI build or stage step, a CLI publish/push/deploy command, and any documented end-to-end publish workflow from the CLI after the shutdown.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
